headline: Saudi Aramco Posts $36 Billion Profit, Sees No Impact From Attacks
summary: Saudi Aramco reported a net profit of $36 billion with revenue rising 20.2% to $123.82 billion, beating analyst estimates, and stated it does not expect financial impacts from attacks on its facilities.
why: Saudi Aramco is the world's largest oil producer, and its financial results and operational security updates directly influence global energy markets.

impacts.name: Saudi Aramco
impacts.why: Strong earnings exceeding expectations and reassurance over facility security support investor sentiment.
